StablePairHook.why: Uniswap Labs' own stablecoin hook, live since September 10. Swaps that push price away from 1:1 pay no fee and corrective swaps go through a decaying auction, so value a flat fee would leak to arbitrage bots stays with LPs.

receipts.title: StablePair Hook: A Fee That Moves with the Market
Keeping Value in the Pool: How StablePair Hook Works

FablesRampETH.why: Fables runs the deepest ETH/USDG pool on Robinhood Chain through this hook. The team says it paid LPs more than twice the fees per dollar of any comparable ETH/USDG pool in mid-September.

receipts.title: Fables: Chapter 4, The Road to TGE

FablesRamp.why: Fables, a ve(3,3)-style exchange live on Robinhood Chain since August 18, uses it for markets where a keeper can override the flat fee for a short, bounded window. Each pool sets its own fee instead of picking a fixed tier.

receipts.title: Meme token swaps boost Robinhood Chain LP fees

Angstrom.why: A per-block auction sells the right to arbitrage the pool and pays the proceeds to LPs, and a batch auction clears every swap at one price so there is nothing to sandwich. LPs keep value when prices move instead of losing it to arbitrage.

receipts.title: Angstrom makes LPs profitable, but at what cost?

HookrModularHookV6.why: The earlier root hook of Hookr, a Robinhood Chain launchpad where creators assemble a pool's hook from blocks like anti-snipe, surge fees and auto-burn, frozen at launch with liquidity locked. New launches use Hookr's newer root, so this is the previous generation still trading.

receipts.title: Introducing Hookr.fun: launchpad with custom Uniswap hooks

Claus.why: An agent-run token whose upgradeable hook changes nearly every day: buyback-and-burn, auto-liquidity, NFT rewards, even a switch tied to Heathrow weather. People are watching a pool that rewrites its own rules in public.

Clanker Dynamic Fee Hook v2 (Base).why: Clanker launches a token straight into a v4 pool when someone tags its bot on Farcaster, with no bonding curve. This hook raises the LP fee when price moves fast, between 0.5% and 5%.
